nativeHandling.note: The title prefix TALK TO and exact English message currently identify this mod’s composer. Replace that ownership test with a language-independent marker before translating either. Do not identify every generic input by its translated text.

Native creation sets CHAT/Chat and fallback Enter/Esc hints. Refresh existing widgets on locale change, and translate only mod-owned Chat widgets. The current ^ENTER status filter is English-specific. Native Messages/Contacts and game SMS stay game-localized.

Immediate queued/unavailable feedback is created in redscript before Lua replies. It needs the same dictionary through a native bridge or a scoped Lua hook. J/L key textures and button codes are not translation strings.
